Papercusp had override settings sprawl: ~13 frontend override UIs (≈8 of them
hand-rolled their own "modified" badge + reset button copy) and ~15 backend
override mechanisms across 7 families, each with its own store, its own diff,
its own reset — the exact opaque-config trap that makes "what did I change away
from defaults, and how do I revoke it all?" unanswerable mid-incident.

The fix is **two contracts**, and every override must conform to one of each:

- **Backend** — a setting mechanism self-registers as a *config-override
  concern* via `registerOverrideConcern` (`config-overrides/registry.ts`). It
  exposes a `.diff()` (what currently diverges from baked defaults: key →
  effective value, layer, default) and a `.reset()`/`.restore()` revert
  primitive. The two generic tools `config:list-overrides` (the audit surface)
  and `config:reset-overrides` (the revoke-all lever, one concern or `all:true`,
  audited + one-call-revertible via the control harness) read across every
  registered concern. **One read answers "what runtime config diverges from
  defaults, by whom, everywhere."**
- **Frontend** — an override UI uses `<OverridableSetting>` rather than
  hand-rolling a "modified" badge + reset button. One component, one copy, one
  reset affordance.
- **Per-user layering** — a concern that layers a per-USER override over a
  workspace base uses the generalized `mergeLayered` helper
  (`config-overrides/layered-setting.ts`): declare the override-eligible key set
  and the rule is shared (null/undefined = "not set" → fall through to base;
  `false`/`0`/`''` are real overriding values). Voice-prefs was the first and is
  still the canonical consumer (`VOICE_USER_OVERRIDE_KEYS`).

## Scope vocabulary

| scope | who it applies to | resolved at |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **global** | the whole install / process (env, host profile) | boot / env read |
| **workspace** | one workspace's operator-state row | `activeWorkspaceId()` |
| **pot** | one pot's `hive_settings` | pot id |
| **user** | one signed-in user, per-workspace (`user_preferences`, migration 304) | session user × workspace |
| **session** | a transient "session-now" steer (no TTL, owner-cleared) | the override row |
| **device** | a client-local value (cpal / MediaDevice ids) | the client |

## Backend mechanisms → scope / persistence / resolution / contract

Resolution order reads **left → right; the LAST present layer wins.**

| family | mechanism | scope | persistence | resolution order | concern (config:list-overrides) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| voice-prefs | workspace voice/operator prefs | workspace (+ user) | `operator_voice_prefs` | DEFAULT_VOICE_PREFS → workspace row → **user** (`mergeLayered` over `VOICE_USER_OVERRIDE_KEYS`) | `voice-prefs` ✅ (P-037) |
| user-prefs | per-user override layer | user | `user_preferences` | workspace value → user value (set-only) | (layer of voice-prefs; not a standalone concern) |
| rate-limit | fleet cap + AIMD floor | workspace | `operator_rate_limit_config` | host-profile seed → workspace row (live bus) | `rate-limit-config` ✅ (P-037) |
| budget | operator daily cap | workspace | `operator_budget` | *unset (null → sizing modal)* → user-chosen cap | **skipped** (see below) |
| agent-config | backend + cmd + per-role/surface model & backend maps | workspace | `operator_agent_config` | DEFAULT_CONFIG → workspace row → boot env mirror | `agent-config` ✅ (P-037) |
| account-override | session-now account allow/exclude steer | session (workspace-level) | `operator_account_override` | empty (no restriction) → owner steer | `account-session-override` ✅ (P-037) |
| backup | backup cadence/retention/destination | workspace | `workspace_backup_settings` (own table) | migration DDL defaults → row | **skipped** (see below) |
| role-grants | runtime role→capability grants (DARK) | workspace | `role_capability_grants` | code BLUEPRINT_ROLE_CAPS → runtime grants (flag-gated) | `role-capability-grants` ✅ (pre-existing) |
| pot-steering | Mug focus / eligible plans / new-work pause | pot | `hive_settings` | unset → owner steer | `pot-control-policy` ✅ (pre-existing) |
| autonomy-policy | auto-implement risk + dispatch limits | workspace | `operator_auto_implement_policy` | DEFAULT → row | `auto-implement-policy` ✅ (pre-existing) |
| effective-tier-config | opus-budget shed bands | workspace | `operator_opus_budget_policy` | DEFAULT_OPUS_BUDGET_POLICY → row | `opus-budget-policy` ✅ (pre-existing) |
| scale-policy | account scale-out trigger | workspace | `operator_scale_policy` | DEFAULT → row | `scale-policy` ✅ (pre-existing) |
| watchdog-tunables | improvement-watchdog bars + caps | workspace | routine `payload_template` | code collector defaults → routine payload (← env `PAPERCUSP_..._MAX_PER_TICK` at tick time) | `watchdog-tunables` ✅ (pre-existing, the P-024 canary) |
| migrate-policy | deploy-migration lock/statement timeout | workspace | `operator_migrate_policy` | DEFAULT → row | `migrate-policy` ✅ (pre-existing) |
| coord-liveness | reclaim / handoff-TTL / reaper grace | workspace | `operator_coord_liveness_config` | DEFAULT → row | `coord-liveness-config` ✅ (pre-existing) |
| capability-envelope | per-role envelope overrides (DARK) | workspace | `operator_capability_envelopes` | code envelope → row (flag-gated) | `capability-envelope-overrides` ✅ (pre-existing) |
| release-checkpoint | green-checkpoint thresholds | workspace | `operator_release_checkpoint_config` | DEFAULT → row | `release-checkpoint-config` ✅ (pre-existing) |
| gym-gates | per-harness gym promotion gates | workspace/pot | (gym-gates store) | DEFAULT → row | `gym-gates` ✅ (pre-existing) |
| scout-workspace-budget | Scout workspace spend-ceiling override | workspace | `operator_scout_budget` | PG override → env `PAPERCUSP_SCOUT_WORKSPACE_CEILING_USD` → `DEFAULT_SCOUT_WORKSPACE_CEILING_USD` | `scout-workspace-budget` ✅ |
| tool-quota-overrides | per-(tool,role) quota overrides | workspace | `operator_quota_overrides` | baked `rolesQuota[role]` → PG override (D-010 sync cache) | `tool-quota-overrides` ✅ |
| telemetry-buffer-config | dispatch telemetry-buffer sizing (maxPending/debounceMs/maxBatch) | workspace | `operator_telemetry_buffer_config` | baked `TELEMETRY_BUFFER_DEFAULTS` → PG override (kill-switch `papercusp-telemetry-buffer-config`, default ON) | `telemetry-buffer-config` ✅ |
| txn-timeouts-config | per-workspace txn `lock_timeout`/`statement_timeout` | workspace | `operator_txn_timeouts_config` | baked 5s/5s (`TXN_TIMEOUTS_DEFAULTS`) → PG override (kill-switch `papercusp-txn-timeouts-config`, default ON) | `txn-timeouts-config` ✅ |
| capability-tier-overrides | per-capability tier reclassification | workspace | `operator_capability_tiers` | baked EXACT table → PG override, **DARK** (`papercusp-auth-config-overrides`) | `capability-tier-overrides` ✅ |
| auth-config-overrides | §G auth/sandbox dials (full-access bypass roles, scoped-SU safe-tools, sandbox mask/egress) | workspace | `operator_auth_config` | baked literals → PG override, **DARK** (`papercusp-auth-config-overrides`); tighten/replace-only, never widens | `auth-config-overrides` ✅ |
| flags | runtime flag overrides | workspace | `operator_flag_overrides` | code flag defaults → row | (flag-bus; not yet a concern) |
| knowledge-packs | installed pack enable/config | workspace/pot | knowledge-pack store | pack default → install row | (not yet a concern) |

### Why two families were skipped (P-037)

- **budget** (`operator_budget`) — there is **no baked default to diff against**:
  the default state is *unset* (`null`), which the UI reads as "show the sizing
  modal", not as a value. `dailyCapUsd` is a deliberate user choice (Light 5 /
  Active 20 / Heavy 50 / custom), and the payload also carries `spend[]`, which
  is accumulated runtime state, not config. A "reset to default" would *destroy*
  the user's chosen cap with nothing meaningful to revert to — it doesn't fit
  the base-vs-override-diff + reset-to-default contract. Left as-is.
- **backup** (`workspace_backup_settings`) — lives in its **own PG table** (not
  operator-state) with defaults expressed only as **migration-DDL column
  defaults**, no importable `DEFAULT_BACKUP_SETTINGS` literal, and no reset
  function. Registering it cleanly means first lifting the DDL defaults into a
  shared literal + adding a reset; tracked as a follow-up rather than bolted on
  awkwardly here.

(`flags` and `knowledge-packs` are likewise candidates for a future concern but
were out of this phase's scope.)

## Guardrail — new override surfaces

**A new override surface MUST conform to BOTH contracts:**

1. **Backend:** the store self-registers via `registerOverrideConcern` (a
   `.diff()` returning what differs from default + a `.reset()`/`.restore()`),
   so it shows up in `config:list-overrides` and is wiped by
   `config:reset-overrides`. Per-user layering goes through `mergeLayered`.
2. **Frontend:** the UI uses `<OverridableSetting>` — do **not** hand-roll a
   "modified" badge or a bespoke reset button.

A new override that skips either contract reintroduces exactly the sprawl this
backbone exists to kill: an override invisible to the audit surface, or yet
another inconsistent badge/reset the user has to learn. If a mechanism genuinely
doesn't fit (no baked default, accumulated state, foreign store — see budget /
backup above), say so explicitly in this table rather than silently omitting it.
